title: Episode Title: Air Canada's A321XLR Face-Plants on London, Delta and United Want to Be Singapore Airlines, and Frontier Guts Elite Status
summary: Air Canada's shiny new A321XLR couldn't even make it through its debut season on the Toronto-London route before getting yanked. Plus, Delta's Ed Bastian and United's Scott Kirby are both suddenly dropping Singapore Airlines and Emirates in interviews, Qantas is retiring the A380 early, and Frontier's elite program gets stripped for parts. Grab a beer, this one's got some good absurdity in it.
